name: hdmi-port
description: An HDMI socket with a contact tongue and two lower chamfers.
useCase: Choose an HDMI input or identify HDMI sockets beside a port label.
misuse: The socket does not indicate a connected cable or a supported display format.

16.reason: A wide socket and thin contact tongue retain 1px of clear air above and below the tongue.

24.reason: The wider socket and contact tongue retain 1.5px of clear air above and below the tongue.
